data.title: Making best use of railway land
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: The Government has extended KiwiRail's leas of railway land by 100 years (to 2170). This provides greater certainty for KiwiRail so it can develop commercial lease opportunities for vacant or unutilised land.

128504.label: Making best use of railway land

data.title: National Day of Reflection: remembering survivors of abuse in care
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: The Government is encouraging New Zealanders to mark today’s National Day of Reflection to remember and acknowledge the survivors of abuse, harm and neglect in care.

128516.label: National Day of Reflection: remembering survivors of abuse in care

data.title: Welcoming progress on proposed wool levy
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Minister Mark Patterson encourages wool growers to engage in the upcoming opportunity to vote on a proposed wool levy.

128517.label: Welcoming progress on proposed wool levy

data.title: Medsafe approves first medicine using the ‘Rule of Two’ pathway
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Paliperidone is the first medicine to be approved in New Zealand via the expedited ‘Rule of Two’ pathway, says Associate Health Minister David Seymour.

128519.label: Medsafe approves first medicine using the ‘Rule of Two’ pathway

data.title: NZ to attend APEC and East Asia Summit
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: New Zealand will be represented by Prime Minister Christopher Luxon and Trade and Investment Minister Todd McClay at the APEC Leaders’ Meeting in China and Foreign Minister Winston Peters at the East Asia Summit in Philippines.

128523.label: NZ to attend APEC and East Asia Summit

data.title: Climate Change Minister heads to COP 31
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Climate Change Minister Simon Watts will travel to Antalya, Türkiye today to attend the 31st annual United Nations Climate Change Summit (COP31).

128526.label: Climate Change Minister heads to COP 31

data.title: Smoking rate falls to 5.9%
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: The latest New Zealand Health Survey (NZHS) results show the daily smoking rate dropping to 5.9 percent – down from 6.7 percent last year and the first time the rate has been below 6 percent.

data.title: New diplomatic appointments
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Foreign Minister Winston Peters has announced new diplomatic appointments to Singapore, Russia, and South Africa.

data.title: NCEA Level 2 English students offered opportunity to re-sit exam
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: Education Minister Erica Stanford has welcomed NZQA's decision to offer students the opportunity to re-sit the NCEA Level 2 English exam following last week's significant disruption.

128533.label: NCEA Level 2 English students offered opportunity to re-sit exam

data.title: Government and Rugby League partner to support better futures for young people
data.author: beehive.govt.nz
data.summary: The Government, with the support of New Zealand Rugby League (NZRL), is partnering with the Australian Rugby League Commission (ARLC) to support better educational, social, and wellbeing outcomes for young people through the positive influence of rugby league role models.

128534.label: Government and Rugby League partner to support better futures for young people
